ask.en: Compared with when you were young, how is the summer heat now?
ask.ta: நீங்கள் இளமையில் இருந்ததோடு ஒப்பிடும்போது, இப்போது கோடை வெப்பம் எப்படி இருக்கிறது?

elderQuestions.check: Ask three people of different ages. Then compare with the IMD record for your nearest station.
elderQuestions.conf: Cities add their own heat. Childhood summers are often remembered outdoors, while today’s heat may be felt indoors.
elderQuestions.sci: India’s average surface temperature rose by roughly 0.7 °C between 1901 and 2018, and heatwaves have become more frequent in many regions (MoES 2020 assessment).

ask.en: Compared with your youth, how often are nights too hot and sticky to sleep well?
ask.ta: இளமைக் காலத்தோடு ஒப்பிடும்போது, தூங்க முடியாத அளவு புழுக்கமான இரவுகள் இப்போது எவ்வளவு அடிக்கடி வருகின்றன?

elderQuestions.check: Compare how your house type and the buildings around it have changed since childhood.
elderQuestions.conf: Concrete roofs hold heat after dark in a way thatched roofs did not. City heat-island effects add to the change.
elderQuestions.sci: Night-time temperatures have been rising in many regions, and warmer air can hold more moisture, which makes heat feel stickier.

ask.en: How far can people now trust the rains to arrive when expected?
ask.ta: மழை எதிர்பார்த்த நேரத்தில் வரும் என்று இப்போது எந்த அளவு நம்பலாம்?

elderQuestions.check: Ask which specific years people remember, then look up the rainfall for those years.
elderQuestions.conf: A few very wet or very dry years dominate memory.
elderQuestions.sci: Studies report weaker June–September rainfall over parts of India since the mid-20th century, with more erratic spells. Tamil Nadu depends heavily on the October–December north-east monsoon, which swings strongly between years.

ask.en: Compared with your youth, how often do sudden, very heavy downpours happen?
ask.ta: இளமையோடு ஒப்பிடும்போது, திடீரெனப் பெய்யும் மிகக் கனமழை எவ்வளவு அடிக்கடி வருகிறது?

elderQuestions.check: Look for local reports of daily rainfall above 100 mm, and walk your street after rain to see where water stands.
elderQuestions.conf: Blocked drains, filled wetlands and paved ground make the same rain feel far worse.
elderQuestions.sci: Heavy-rain events have increased in many parts of India, consistent with warmer air holding about 7% more moisture for each 1 °C of warming.

ask.en: How much water do wells and ponds hold in the dry months, compared with before?
ask.ta: முன்பைவிட, வறண்ட மாதங்களில் கிணறுகளிலும் குளங்களிலும் எவ்வளவு நீர் இருக்கிறது?

elderQuestions.check: Count borewells now versus in your elder’s youth. Ask when the village tank was last desilted.
elderQuestions.conf: Everyone may agree the water table fell, yet the main cause is often how much is pumped out.
elderQuestions.sci: Climate affects rainfall and recharge, but in most villages pumping, borewells, silted tanks and land-use change dominate groundwater trends.

title.en: Water in wells and ponds in dry months

ask.en: Has the sea come closer or the shore eroded, compared with before? (Skip if you live far from the coast.)
ask.ta: முன்பைவிட கடல் நெருங்கி வந்திருக்கிறதா, கரை அரிப்பு அதிகமா? (கடலிலிருந்து தொலைவில் இருந்தால் தவிர்க்கவும்.)

elderQuestions.check: Ask where the old shoreline was, then compare with a map or satellite view and note any harbour or sea-wall built nearby.
elderQuestions.conf: Do not mix up the 2004 tsunami, which was caused by an earthquake, with climate-driven change.
elderQuestions.sci: Global sea level rose about 20 cm between 1901 and 2018, and the rise is speeding up. Local erosion also depends strongly on harbours, sand mining, reduced river sediment, mangrove loss and cyclones.

title.en: Sea reaching the land, shore erosion
title.ta: கடல் நிலத்தை நோக்கி வருவது, கரை அரிப்பு

ask.en: Compared with before, how steady are fish catches or harvests from year to year?
ask.ta: முன்பைவிட, மீன்பிடி அல்லது விளைச்சல் ஆண்டுதோறும் எவ்வளவு நிலையாக இருக்கிறது?

elderQuestions.check: Ask what changed in the way they fish or farm, not only in the results.
elderQuestions.conf: Better boats and seeds can hide a climate effect, and worse markets can exaggerate one.
elderQuestions.sci: Rainfall variability and ocean warming can shift crops and fish, but irrigation, seed varieties, prices, fleet size and overfishing change yields too.

ask.en: How many sparrows, dragonflies, fireflies and similar creatures do you see now?
ask.ta: சிட்டுக்குருவி, தும்பி, மின்மினி போன்றவற்றை இப்போது எவ்வளவு காண்கிறீர்கள்?

elderQuestions.check: Count the species you can find in 15 minutes near the home. Ask what was built, sprayed or lit up nearby.
elderQuestions.conf: Many people report a decline here. Shared experience is not proof of one cause.
elderQuestions.sci: Habitat loss, pesticides, night lighting and urban growth are major drivers of bird and insect declines. Climate adds pressure but is rarely the only cause.

ask.en: How cold are the winter mornings (Margazhi–Thai) now?
ask.ta: மார்கழி–தை மாத அதிகாலைகளில் இப்போது எவ்வளவு குளிர் இருக்கிறது?

elderQuestions.check: Compare minimum temperatures at the nearest IMD station for recent and older decades.
elderQuestions.conf: Trees, buildings and open ground change how cold a particular spot feels.
elderQuestions.sci: Cold nights and mornings have become less frequent in many regions as average temperatures rose.

ask.en: How often do damaging storms or floods happen now?
ask.ta: சேதம் செய்யும் புயல்கள், வெள்ளங்கள் இப்போது எவ்வளவு அடிக்கடி வருகின்றன?

elderQuestions.check: List the storms your elder names with years, then count how many people and houses were in harm’s way then versus now.
elderQuestions.conf: Notable storms are remembered; exposure has grown as more people live near the coast.
elderQuestions.sci: North Indian Ocean cyclones show no clear long-term rise in number, but the strongest storms and heavy rainfall are intensifying, and higher seas worsen storm surge. Floods also follow lost drainage and building on floodplains.
